title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Region-Aware Consistency Repair of Backdoors in MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.24354v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: MLLMs are increasingly deployed in user-facing applications, yet they inherit backdoor risks from the pipelines used to construct them: triggers may reside in images, texts, or both. Existing model-level backdoor removal methods, largely designed for conventional classifiers, show limited effectiveness on MLLMs, while MLLM-specific defenses mainly operate at inference time, filtering suspicious inputs without removing the backdoor embedded in the model. To address this gap and eliminate latent backdoors from MLLMs at their source, we present RACER, a model-level repair framework motivated by a key observation: backdoors induce abnormal layer-to-layer evolution in internal representations, which we term the layer-wise inconsistency anomaly. translated_title: 并非所有令牌都平等：多模态大语言模型中后门的区域感知一致性修复
translated_abstract: 摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）越来越多地部署在面向用户的应用中，但它们继承了构建流程中的后门风险：触发器可能存在于图像、文本或两者中。现有的模型级后门移除方法，主要针对传统分类器设计，在MLLMs上效果有限，而针对MLLMs的特定防御主要在推理时操作，过滤可疑输入而不移除模型中嵌入的后门。为解决这一差距并从源头消除MLLMs中的潜在后门，我们提出了RACER，一种模型级修复框架，其动机源于一个关键观察：后门在内部表示中引起异常的层间演化，我们称之为层间不一致异常。重要的是，这种异常是模态依赖的，主要集中在编码后门模型实际依赖的触发器特征的令牌区域。因此，RACER将f（注：原文此处截断，推测为“将修复过程分解”）
tldr: 本文提出RACER，一种基于层间一致性异常的模型级后门修复框架，通过识别并修复多模态大语言模型中模态相关的异常令牌区域，从源头消除后门，优于传统方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RACER, a model-level backdoor repair framework leveraging layer-wise inconsistency anomalies to identify and fix modality-dependent abnormal token regions in MLLMs, eliminating backdoors at their source and outperforming existing methods.
